note: Shared Services BC (launched as Solutions BC on 1 April 2003) and the Information Technology Services Division that received BC Systems Corporation's staff and business in 1996, added 2026-11-13 from the ministries' own service plans and annual reports, re-read that day, and BC Systems' last financial statements. Both are ministry organizations, not Crown corporations: neither is BC Systems renamed. What carried BC Systems' functions into them is recorded as events (research/atlas/events-shared-services-2026-11-13.json). Whether the Information Technology Services Division became the Common Information Technology Services division that joined Solutions BC is not established by a source read here, so neither record names the other as predecessor. Filed as agencies, the nearest kind the atlas has for a ministry division with a life of its own.

records.description: The government’s internal shared-services organization, a part of the ministry responsible for government services rather than a Crown corporation. Launched on 1 April 2003 as Solutions BC, it brought together the Ministry of Management Services’ Procurement and Supply Services, the payroll, desktop and helpdesk IT services and Corporate Accounting Service transferred from other ministries, and the rest of the ministry’s Common Information Technology division. Called Public Service Operations in September 2005 and Shared Services BC by February 2006, it took over the accommodation and real estate services of the former BC Buildings Corporation on 1 April 2006. In 2013 it was three divisions: Technology Solutions, Logistics and Business Services, and Integrated Workplace Solutions. Its name is last used in 2015. Among its predecessors in function is BC Systems Corporation’s central IT role, but the line from the Information Technology Services Division of 1996 to the Common Information Technology division of 2003 is not established here.
